acceptance_criterion.requirement_text: FARIS shall never turn a tally with a 1-sigma error into a margin without showing the error band.
acceptance_criterion.acceptance_text: Margin shown as value with 2-sigma band; verdict uses the unfavourable edge; 100% of margin displays carry the band.
acceptance_criterion.evidence_policy: Display completeness only; does not qualify transport convergence, physical accuracy, service life, or underlying models.

scope.policy: A displayed margin must show its typed two-sigma interval and the verdict must use the unfavourable edge; when the stored state has no interval, show its reason and next step. Comparison deltas may show the two source intervals and an overlap/separation verdict, but must not fabricate an interval of the difference.
scope.exclusions: Raw fluence timelines with service-limit reference lines and P5-P95 transport-sampling shading, plus inspector source values, do not calculate or claim a numeric margin, headroom, percent-of-limit, or verdict. P5-P95 is not a two-sigma margin.
scope.review: All 18 registered surfaces are present and have named fixture functions. Numeric margins carry typed two-sigma intervals or stored why/next states; verdicts use the unfavourable edge. Deltas retain both source intervals and an overlap/separation/no-band verdict without fabricating a delta interval.

prior_receipt.disposition: Superseded 14-surface receipt; retained as historical evidence. It omitted four app readout surfaces, which are now included and have passing rendered fixtures.

fixture_execution: The v107 history-panel log reports 21 passed, including all newly added inspector/cursor/hover/event fixtures. The v107 registry log reports 18/18 callbacks, quantity contracts and fixture functions present; it is an inventory check, not a substitute for executing fixtures. The prior receipt records passing fixture evidence for the original 14 surfaces.
